title_tr: Proje üyesi olmayan kullanıcı @mention ile bildirim alıyor
issue: If someone mentions a user who is not a member of the project in a task comment, that user gets a notification containing the task title, leaking information about a project they cannot see. Only project members should be notified.

bug.find:
if not permissions.can_view(project, user.id):
                continue  # never notify people about projects they cannot see

ground_truth.root_cause: CommentService._resolve_mentions adds every user found by handle to mentioned_ids without checking project membership (permissions.can_view), and the dispatcher notifies all mentioned users.
ground_truth.fix: Skip users for whom permissions.can_view(project, user.id) is False in _resolve_mentions.
